description: Backend: Add GET /api/pathology/trends/ endpoint + POST /api/predictions/simulate/ endpoint + POST /api/ai/explain/ endpoint. These are the pure backend additions needed before any frontend work. Frontend: Feature 6 (Light/Dark Theme) — ThemeContext + CSS variable conversion + Navbar toggle. Theme is first because it touches index.css and App.jsx globally and must be stable before other features add UI.
steps: STEP 1 — Backend: Add EmergencyToken model to backend/medical/models.py. Add fields: patient (OneToOneField to Patient, CASCADE, related_name='emergency_token'), token (CharField max_length=64, unique=True), created_at (auto_now_add), expires_at (null=True blank=True DateTimeField), is_active (BooleanField default=True).
STEP 2 — Backend migrations: cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py makemigrations && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py migrate

STEP 3 — Backend views.py: Add import for 'secrets' at top. Add 4 new view functions:
  (a) get_pathology_trends(request) — GET, IsAuthenticated. Gets Patient for request.user, fetches all PathologyReport records ordered by created_at, parses each report_data JSON list of {name,value,unit}, groups by biomarker name (case-insensitive strip), returns {trends: {BiomarkerName: {unit: str, data: [{date: str, value: float, source_id: int}]}}}. Handle Patient.DoesNotExist → return {trends: {}} with 200.
  (b) simulate_prediction(request) — POST, no auth. Parse {disease_type, parameters} from request.body. Call ai_service._predict_using_ml(disease_type, parameters) directly. If result is None use rule-based score from a simplified inline fallback (same logic as _get_fallback_prediction but skip saving). Return {simulated_score: X, simulated_level: str, factors: [...]}. Do NOT create PredictionRecord.
  (c) generate_emergency_token(request) — POST, IsAuthenticated. Get patient for user. Deactivate any existing EmergencyToken for patient (is_active=False). Create new EmergencyToken with secrets.token_urlsafe(32). Return {token: str, url: '/emergency/{token}'}.
  (d) revoke_emergency_token(request) — DELETE, IsAuthenticated. Get patient's EmergencyToken, set is_active=False, save. Return 204.
  (e) get_emergency_card(request, token) — GET, no auth. Look up EmergencyToken by token where is_active=True. Get patient. Get latest Prescription for active meds. Return {name, vault_id, blood_group, allergies, emergency_contact, active_meds, last_updated}. 404 if not found.
  (f) explain_result(request) — POST, no auth. Parse {text, language}. If language=='en' return {explanation: text} immediately. Else call Gemini with translation prompt. Return {explanation: str}.

STEP 4 — Backend urls.py: Add these URL patterns:
  re_path(r'^pathology/trends/?$', views.get_pathology_trends, name='pathology_trends')
  re_path(r'^predictions/simulate/?$', views.simulate_prediction, name='simulate_prediction')
  re_path(r'^emergency/generate/?$', views.generate_emergency_token, name='generate_emergency_token')
  re_path(r'^emergency/revoke/?$', views.revoke_emergency_token, name='revoke_emergency_token')
  re_path(r'^emergency/(?P<token>[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/?$', views.get_emergency_card, name='get_emergency_card')
  re_path(r'^ai/explain/?$', views.explain_result, name='explain_result')
  IMPORTANT: The pathology/trends route must be placed BEFORE the existing pathology/ route in urls.py to avoid shadowing.

STEP 5 — Backend ai_service.py: Modify _predict_using_ml to also return feature importances. Change return type to Optional[dict]. After loading model and computing score, also compute: importances = model.feature_importances_. Zip importances with the disease-specific feature name list. Build factors list: sorted by importance desc, take top 5, each as {feature: str, importance: float, value: any}. Return {score: float, factors: [...]}.  Feature name arrays (matching exact numpy feature order in the method):
  Heart: ['Age','Gender','Systolic BP','Diastolic BP','Cholesterol','Max Heart Rate','Chest Pain','Exercise Angina','Fasting Sugar','Shortness of Breath','Left Arm Pain']
  Diabetes: ['Age','Gender','Glucose','HbA1c','BMI','Hypertension','Heart Disease','Family History','Excessive Thirst','Frequent Urination','Blurry Vision','Slow Healing Sores']
  Cancer: ['Age','Gender','Family History','Smoking','Alcohol','Toxin Exposure','Weight Loss','Persistent Cough','Fatigue','Skin/Mole Changes','Unusual Lumps']
  Update _get_fallback_prediction to handle: ml_result = _predict_using_ml(...); if ml_result is not None: risk_score = ml_result['score']; factors = ml_result['factors']; add 'factors' key to returned dict.
  Update predict_health_risk to include factors from either Gemini response or fallback.
  Update run_prediction view in views.py to include factors=[analysis.get('factors', [])] in the JsonResponse (not stored in PredictionRecord).
STEP 6 — Backend: Run manage.py check to confirm 0 issues.

STEP 7 — Frontend: Create src/context/ThemeContext.jsx. Content: React createContext ThemeContext. ThemeProvider reads/writes localStorage key 'medfusion-theme', defaults to 'dark'. Sets document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme) on change. Exports useTheme hook.

STEP 8 — Frontend App.jsx: Import ThemeProvider from ./context/ThemeContext. Wrap the return of App() in <ThemeProvider>. Import Sun and Moon from lucide-react. In the Navbar function, import useTheme. Add theme toggle button next to existing nav items in both desktop and mobile nav: when theme==='dark' show Sun icon, when 'light' show Moon icon. Use style matching existing btn-icon class.

STEP 9 — Frontend src/index.css: At the very top of the file (before existing :root block OR by replacing/augmenting it), add: [data-theme='dark'] (same as :root) and [data-theme='light'] variable blocks as specified. Update body to use var(--bg-deep) and var(--text-primary). Update .glass-card background to var(--bg-card), border-color to var(--border-color). Add nav.bg-glass background: var(--nav-bg). Add .app-sidebar background: var(--bg-surface). Update input/select/textarea to use var(--input-bg) and var(--input-text). Add .text-secondary color: var(--text-secondary) override for light theme. Keep all existing dark theme values matching their current hardcoded equivalents so dark mode looks identical to today.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/predictions/simulate/ returns {simulated_score, simulated_level, factors} without creating DB record
POST /api/emergency/generate/ creates EmergencyToken and returns token+url
GET /api/emergency/{token}/ returns patient emergency card data without auth
POST /api/ai/explain/ returns translated explanation for 'ta' or 'hi', and passes through for 'en'
_predict_using_ml now returns {score: float, factors: [...]} dict or None
App.jsx wraps in ThemeProvider and Navbar has Sun/Moon toggle button
verification: cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py check 2>&1 (expect: System check identified no issues)
cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\frontend && node_modules\.bin\vite build 2>&1 (expect: built in X.Xs)
